eligibility.quote: I did some debugging into this and I definitely can see the issue.

failed_conditions.quote: The issue is with the action client, not with BufferClient (state is available before result).

Cranking the rate up to 100000 I was also able to get a double answer: 

```
$ python test.py 
[ERROR] [WallTime: 1464801977.428899] Received comm state ACTIVE when in simple state DONE with SimpleActionClient in NS /tf2_buffer_server
[ERROR] [WallTime: 1464801978.438880] SimpleActionClient received DONE twice

loudness.quote:
File "/opt/ros/indigo/lib/python2.7/dist-packages/tf2_ros/buffer_client.py", line 127, in __process_result
    raise tf2.TransformException("The BufferServer returned None for result or result.error!  Something is likely wrong with the server.")

resolution.quote: From this short test I believe that the problem was partially mitigated. In fact, no more tf errors are thrown, however there is still something wrong with the tf state machine.

notes: ActionClient state reported SUCCEEDED before get_result() returned the result in SimpleActionClient.
